Get Involved

Volunteer

We’re on the front lines of the issues that affect LGBTQ Ohioans — from discrimination to HIV policy reform to pushing back against conversion therapy — Equality Ohio is there. Join us: tell us where you are and how you’d like to help.

Design preview — this recreates Equality Ohio’s volunteer sign‑up form, but it isn’t connected yet and nothing you type is saved or sent. To volunteer today, use Equality Ohio’s volunteer sign‑up form on EveryAction or email info@equalityohio.org.

“*” indicates required fields

All states will be listed in the production build.

Interests

You’re signed up — in the real build.

This preview didn’t save or send anything. In production, your sign‑up would go to Equality Ohio’s organizing team through EveryAction. Want to volunteer right now? Use Equality Ohio’s volunteer sign‑up form on EveryAction or email info@equalityohio.org.
